deploy-bot: [DEPLOY START] user=alice env=production tag=v1.12.5-hotfix-20260320 commit=de9f3a4 service=api-gateway

alice: Starting hotfix deploy to prod. Tagged release pushed: `git tag -a v1.12.5-hotfix-20260320 -m "hotfix: session timeout regression" && git push origin v1.12.5-hotfix-20260320`

carl: Quick heads up — this includes a rollback guard to v1.12.4 and a model pin to model@2026-03-18. Monitor 5xx and tail logs.

tina: @alice Can we run canary at 5% first? Want to validate auth flows. I'll monitor dashboards.

jamal: OK. If errors > 0.5% request error rate in 2m, we roll back. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: [CANARY START] env=production canary=5% targets=api-gw-*/canary commit=de9f3a4

carl: Seeing slight increase in 502s on a single host, investigating logs.

tina: Smoke tests running: login, session-refresh, token-exchange

deploy-bot: [CANARY REPORT] canary=5% success=99.98% 5xx=0.2% latency_p95=210ms

carl: 502s caused by upstream timeout, bumped timeout 30s->45s on canary nodes. Re-running canary.

deploy-bot: [CANARY UPDATE] restarted canary nodes with timeout fix

tina: Re-checking smoke — auth flows now pass on canary.

alice: Given fix, bump canary to 25% and hold for 5m.

deploy-bot: [CANARY START] canary=25% from=5% -> targets=api-gw-*/canary

deploy-bot: [CANARY REPORT] canary=25% success=99.99% 5xx=0.05% latency_p95=220ms

jamal: LGTM. If no regressions in 10m, promote to 100%.

alice: Approving promote. Ensure pinned model remains model@2026-03-18.

deploy-bot: [PROMOTE START] target=production_percent:100 tag=v1.12.5-hotfix-20260320
deploy-bot: [PROMOTE FINISH] status=success duration=4m commit=de9f3a4

alice: Release notes: hotfix for session timeout regression; rollback guard to v1.12.4; model pinned to model@2026-03-18. I'll update the changelog and release ticket.

carl: Removing canary flag from infra, everything green in Datadog. :tada:

deploy-bot: [DEPLOY FINISHED] env=production tag=v1.12.5-hotfix-20260320 status=success

alice: Postmortem not required — small rollback-ready hotfix. Thanks team.
